newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE canola ends up on crusher bull spreads, CBOT.
newsitem.headline: WCE canola ends up on crusher bull spreads, CBOT.

text.p: WCE canola ended up on 1,500 Jan-March crusher bull spreads and firmer CBOT soycomplex values, traders said.

"Crushers were huge buyers of the Jan-March spread, 1,000 at even money, 500 at C$0.50 and they were bidding for 500 more at the close," a trader said. January futures crush margin rose to -40.63 from -42.48 Wednesday on January soyoil, meal. Volume was 8,332 lots or 166,640 tonnes, and 575 hedges.
Japan bought 3,000-4,000 tonnes overnight, sources said.
January canola finished up $2.70 to $406.40 and March up $3.40 to $406.80. January flax rose $0.40 at $355.90 on commercial demand with gains capped by hedges.

December feed wheat rose $2 to $166, March settled $2 higher at $168.70 on spillover support from the USDA's supply/demand report and commercial short covering. Dec-Mar spread at $1, Mar-July $1, May-July $1. Volume was 900 lots.
February western barley rose $0.30 to $140 with Alberta Wheat Pool selling to UGG, traders said. May closed up $0.30 at $140.50. Feb-May spread at $0.50. Volume was 1,500 lots.
Oats and peas did not trade.
(All values in Canadian dollars per tonne except peas, oats).
